Update inventory records regularly using company inventory software. Conduct regular physical stock counts and reconcile physical stock with system records. Identify and report stock shortages, excess quantities, damaged products, and inventory discrepancies . Monitor stock levels and communicate potential stock shortages or overstock situations to the concerned team. Ensure products are properly labeled, organized, and stored for easy identification and retrieval. Assist in maintaining proper inventory aging and stock rotation practices. Warehouse Operations Receive incoming products and verify quantity, SKU, size, color, and condition against invoices/packing lists. Coordinate picking and packing activities according to customer orders. Verify products before dispatch to minimize wrong-product, wrong-size, and quantity-related errors. Maintain proper records of warehouse receiving and dispatch activities. Ensure the warehouse remains organized and products are stored safely. Requirements Education B.Sc. in Textile Engineering / Fashion Designing / related discipline from a recognized institution. Candidates having knowledge of Seamless Knitting/Seamless Garments will be preferred. Experience At most 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Garments, Textile, Group of Companies Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age 26 to 30 years Only Male Basic knowledge of inventory and store management. Basic knowledge of 5S and warehouse/store practices. Basic knowledge of ERP/software-based inventory management will be an advantage. Understanding of garments/textile production processes. Good numerical and analytical ability. Strong attention to detail.Self-driven and responsible. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Positive mindset and willingness to learn. Ability to work with different departments and under pressure. Experience: 0–6 months / Freshers are encouraged to apply. Internship or practical experience in store, inventory or garments/textile operations will be an advantage. Responsibilities & Context Assist in the day-to-day operation and management of the Seamless Store . Receive, check, arrange and issue raw materials, accessories and other store items according to approved requirements. Maintain proper inventory records, stock registers and system records . Support accurate stock receiving, issuing, transfer and reconciliation . Monitor stock levels and communicate shortages or excess inventory to the concerned authority. Ensure proper identification, tagging, storage and preservation of materials. Follow FIFO/FEFO principles wherever applicable. Assist in conducting regular physical stock counting and reconciliation. Maintain proper housekeeping and 5S practices within the store. Support reduction of material wastage, loss and inventory discrepancies. Coordinate with Production, Planning, Knitting, Technical, Procurement and Accounts departments regarding material requirements. Assist in maintaining proper documentation for material receiving and issuing. Ensure materials are stored safely and systematically to facilitate easy identification and retrieval. Support implementation of best practices for inventory and store management . Perform any other duties assigned by the management. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540349&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor/Masters degree in Business Administration, Economics, Procurement, Supply Chain Management or similar degree, or equivalent professional qualification (intermediate CIPS) Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO Additional Requirements Age At least 25 years At least 2 years’ experience in Procurement or Supply Chain Management. Ability to read and write in Bangla and English. The position requires ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally up to 10% of the time Can-do attitude, Results-oriented approach, Proactive mindset, Quick learner, Team player, Focus on impact, etc. Ability to work under stressful condition and adaptive to local culture and situation. Must be able to do multiple tasks and willingness to travel in various locations of BRCR as required. Responsibilities & Context Position Purpose: This Purpose of Position will be used in the WVI or local Careers site, and if applicable, advertisements. Please describe the role in 2-3 concise sentences. Focus on the core of what this role is supposed to achieve. Describe the purpose of this position and how this position contributes to achieving department objectives and the management and performance of others. Provide strategic leadership and oversight of the Supply Chain function to ensure the timely, compliant, and cost-effective procurement and delivery of goods and services that support World Vision’s programs and operations. Lead and develop the Supply Chain team while driving process improvement, standardization, and value-for-money initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and stewardship of resources. Through effective supply chain management, the role contributes to the achievement of organizational objectives and World Vision’s Child Well-Being Outcomes. Key Responsibilities: Business Requirements: Understand the department's business requirements and apply in the day-to-day work. Planning: Advise and seek approval of internal customers of modifications from original requests. Facilitates across all parties the timely resolution of issues that could impact meeting the needs of the requestor and communities. Identify alternative supply sources for materials / services not under contract Work with Logistics to ensure safe delivery and receipt of ordered materials Resolve conflicts with deliveries and suppliers Strategic Sourcing Execute the Market Assessment and Supplier Pre-Qualification process as per the set guidelines based on the set guidelines for the assigned categories. Manage the RFQ/RFP Process including baselines & price survey methodologies as per the approved framework for the assigned categories. Lead negotiations for the assigned Categories. Supervise the Sourcing events Filed Offices and Assistance work relating to sourcing. Preparation of Procurement Committee submission documents to ensure their comprehensiveness to allow an informed decision making process. Facilitate Purchasing Committee meetings and ensure that proper documentation is maintained. Supplier Contract and Relationship Management Accurately complete the master data management form (or contract/supplier register) Monitor and complete contract close-out, renewal or retender, as appropriate for the assigned commodities. Ensure that contractual conditions and performance indicators are understood by the suppliers. Identify & resolve or escalate contract-related issues both internally and externally. Analyze supplier performance based on customer feedback information & other sources and coordinate with supplier for improvement. Procurement Execution Receive incoming Purchase Requisitions (Pending Buyer Action), verify specifications are clear, conduct sourcing event if required items are not already on contract, update the PR with actual supplier record and release PR for approval. Follow Procurement Polices and guidelines in Supplier Award decisions under the applicable threshold. Manage PO Change requests coordinating with Requesters, Budget Owners and Suppliers Consolidates all required documentation for presentation to Finance for timely supplier payment for materials and services delivered Data Management, Analysis and Reporting Collect and analyze organization-wide data to support decision-making Provide support in the design of the business metrics to monitor SCM performance and alert management when the performance trigger is violated Conduct spend analysis to support strategic sourcing activities, and Supplier Relationship Management Prepare summary report of supplier bid responses for Procurement Committee award decision meetings Track and analyze procurement performance and savings against established target levels Process, Procedure and Policy Conduct all procurement-related tasks as per the approved procurement policies, processes and guidelines. Advice management regarding any challenge / risks / impractical guidelines. Collect customer feedback relating to the policies, processes and guidelines, and report to NO Management for improvements or changes. Review with Partners / Sub-Grantees, their SCM Policies, procedures and etc. to identify any gaps, document them under assessment reports, and capture under capacity building plans Systems Development and Implementation Collect and collate useful data which can be used to improve the general systems established and communicate this information to immediate Supervisor Control and Compliance Conduct supplier pre-qualification for all new suppliers and maintain records. Participate in development of risk identification & assessment tools, registers and other tools and assessing SCM and contractual risks for procurement of goods, works or services. Maintain proper filing and record keeping as per the guidelines set by the management. Coordinate with Requesters to close out open POs in a timely manner. Requirements Education Post-graduate degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field. Experience At least 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO Responsibilities & Context Reports to: Project Manager, Sustho Sagor Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh (with field visits as required) Duration: 600 days (between November 2026 and October 2029) Liaison: Maintain regular work relationships with the Marine Conservation Program, and liaison with the Blue Action Fund Project Manager, Educational Outreach Program Coordinator, Procurement and Logistic Officer, Senior Finance Officer, and Human Resources (HR) Manager of WCS to ensure effective coordination and implementation of assigned activities. Background Wildlife Conservation Society Bangladesh Program is implementing the project, titled Sustho Sagor (Healthy Ocean) - Sharing responsibilities and benefits from well managed MPAs for a healthy ocean and thriving communities in Bangladesh, funded by the Blue Action Fund. The project aims to strengthen the network of ecologically representative MPAs and OECMs, improve MPA governance, and support sustainable livelihoods for coastal communities through capacity building, stakeholder engagement, field surveys, and public outreach. Effective delivery of these activities depends on timely, well-organized logistics across project sites, many of which are in remote coastal areas where WCS does not have a permanent presence. To support effective implementation of the project’s training, survey, outreach, and field activities and the associated financial, asset, and human resources requirements, WCS Bangladesh intends to engage a suitably qualified Logistics Management Consultant. Objectives: The objective of this consultancy is to ensure efficient, timely, and compliant logistical support for trainings, workshops, field surveys, outreach events, and other activities under the Sustho Sagor project, and to support program staff in fulfilling related financial, asset management, and human resources requirements. The consultant will achieve this by managing event and field logistics, processing purchase requisitions and field expense settlements, supporting procurement, documenting assets taken to and returned from the field, and providing human resources and administrative support, including onboarding, agreement preparation, and payment processing. Responsibilities & Context Coordinate day-to-day business development activities and follow up on leads. Assist the Business Development Team in preparing proposals, presentations, quotations, and reports. Maintain and update client databases and track sales activities and opportunities. Responsibilities & Context Planet Freight Services Ltd. a concern of Topstar Group, established in 1997, has grown into a leading freight forwarding company by consistently delivering high-quality logistics services. The company continuously invests in employee training, modern technology, and updated business practices to meet the evolving demands of global trade. With an experienced workforce and advanced infrastructure, it provides reliable, efficient, and customer-focused omni-channel logistics solutions. Key Responsibilities Communicating with customers through various channels regarding air export shipments. Keep constant contact with assigned overseas agents, airlines, and shippers for smooth handling of the shipments. Follow up SOP for every customer and ensure timely execution of all air export shipments. Providing clearance to the Air Operation team for planning, mentioning booking no., agent detail, preferred airline, selling rate, flight details, and estimated arrival time through mail only. Coordinate with the Air Operation team regarding cargo handover, flight confirmation, documentation, and urgent consignments. Follow up on AWB, HAWB/MAWB and other required air export documentation to ensure timely shipment processing. Sometimes communicate over the phone for urgent consignments and shipment-related matters. Ability to meet deadlines while maintaining a professional attitude. jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540660&fc.source_content:
Requirements Education Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) in Supply Chain Management, Accounting, Management Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Accounting, Management or a relevant discipline from a recognized university Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Manufacturing (FMCG), Agro based firms (incl. Agro Processing/Seed/GM) Additional Requirements Minimum 2–3 years of practical experience in Store Operations, preferably in a factory/FMCG/food manufacturing environment. Candidates with hands-on experience in raw materials, packaging materials and finished goods management will be preferred. Key Skills Good knowledge of inventory and store management. Practical knowledge of FIFO/FEFO, stock reconciliation and physical inventory counting. Good computer skills, particularly MS Excel and inventory/ERP software. Strong documentation, communication and coordination skills. Ability to work under pressure and maintain accuracy in stock-related activities. Responsibilities & Context Receive, inspect and properly record all incoming raw materials, packaging materials, finished goods and other store items. Ensure proper storage, identification, stacking and preservation of materials according to company procedures. Maintain accurate stock records, bin cards, stock registers and system entries. Issue materials against authorized requisitions and maintain proper documentation. Conduct regular physical stock verification and reconcile physical stock with system/record balances. Monitor stock levels and inform the concerned authority regarding shortages, excess stock, slow-moving and obsolete items. Ensure FIFO/FEFO practices where applicable, particularly for food/raw materials and other time-sensitive items. Coordinate with Production, Procurement, Quality Assurance, Accounts and other relevant departments for smooth store operations. Maintain proper housekeeping, safety, security and hygiene standards within the store. Prepare regular stock reports and support management during stock audits and inspections. Perform any other store-related duties assigned by management. Compensation & Other Benefits Salary Negotiable, based on qualifications and experience. Other benefits will be provided as per company policy. Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Mymensingh
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

Responsibilities & Context Job Context: Dhaka Ahsania Mission (DAM) is a non-government development organization founded in 1958 by Khan Bahadur Ahsanullah, an eminent educationist, reformer, and Sufi with the aim of social and spiritual development of the entire human community. DAM has been contributing for the betterment of the disadvantaged population through operating 35 institutions and also 8 sectors of development. The Health and Nutrition Sector is one of the core sectors of DAM which has also been operating 7 institutions and 9 projects. DAM Health and Nutrition Sector is going to recruit a competent and self-motivated individual for the position of Accounts and Admin Officer for "Mayer Hashi General Hospital and Diagnostic Center" at Ashulia, Dhaka. Job Responsibility: Oversee day-to-day administrative operations, including scheduling, inventory management, and facility coordination, to ensure efficient hospital functioning. Assist central HR in the overall recruitment and employee HR relevant relevant process. Coordinate effectively with various departments to facilitate smooth and uninterrupted hospital operations. Supervise and manage support staff, including clerical, front desk, housekeeping, and other administrative personnel. Assist in the development, implementation, and periodic review of hospital policies, procedures, and compliance standards. Maintain accurate, confidential, and up-to-date patient records, administrative documentation, and institutional files. Monitor administrative workflows and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and service quality. Manage patient billing, invoicing, account reconciliation, and related financial documentation. Oversee payroll processing and ensure timely and accurate payments to employees, suppliers, and service providers. Prepare and maintain financial reports, budgets, cash-flow projections, and periodic financial forecasts. Monitor hospital expenditures, control operational costs, and implement appropriate cost-saving measures. Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants, financial institutions, and relevant regulatory authorities as required. Ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations, accounting standards, tax requirements, and internal hospital policies. Maintain proper financial records and supporting documentation for audit, reporting, and management review purposes. Provide management with timely financial and administrative information to support effective planning and decision-making. Perform any other tasks time to time given by the authority. As a member of the organization, uphold and comply with DAM’s Safeguarding Policies and Code of Conduct, and take appropriate action to prevent, report, and respond to safeguarding concerns in accordance with established procedures. Requirements Education Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or any relevant discipline. MBA/Masters degree in Marketing or Management will be an advantage. Experience 2 to 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Automobile Additional Requirements Age 25 to 35 years Only Male Typically 2–3 years of relevant experience in sales, preferably in the motorcycle, automobile, automotive parts, or related industry. Experience in dealer management, retail sales, territory management, and market development will be preferred. Responsibilities & Context The Territory Sales Manager (TSM) will be responsible for achieving motorcycle sales targets, developing and managing the dealer network, expanding market coverage, and increasing the companys market share within the assigned territory. The position requires extensive fieldwork, strong dealer relationships, market analysis, and effective execution of sales and promotional strategies. Key Responsibilities Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual motorcycle sales targets for the assigned territory. Manage, develop, and maintain strong relationships with authorized dealers and sub-dealers. Identify and appoint potential new dealers to expand market coverage. Monitor dealer-wise and model-wise sales performance and take corrective actions where required. Drive secondary/retail sales through dealers and ensure regular product availability. Conduct frequent market and dealer visits to monitor sales, stock, showroom activities, and customer demand. Develop new markets and identify opportunities for increasing motorcycle penetration. Monitor competitors pricing, products, offers, promotions, dealer activities, and market strategies. Implement company-approved sales campaigns, promotional activities, branding, and merchandising programs. Train and motivate dealer sales teams on product features, customer handling, and sales techniques. Monitor dealer inventory and coordinate with relevant teams to maintain optimum stock levels. Support dealers in resolving sales, service, documentation, and customer-related issues. Monitor customer feedback and ensure proper resolution of complaints in coordination with the service team. Follow up on motorcycle registration/documentation processes where applicable. Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly sales, stock, market, and competitor reports. Analyze territory sales data and prepare sales forecasts and action plans. Ensure compliance with company pricing, branding, sales, and operational policies. Monitor dealer showroom standards, product display, signage, and promotional materials. Maintain strong relationships with dealers, customers, and other relevant market stakeholders. Perform any other sales-related responsibilities assigned by management. Requirements Education HSC Bachelor/Honors Diploma Experience 1 to 2 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): E-commerce, Educational Technology (Edtech) Startup, Telecommunication Freshers are also encouraged to apply. Additional Requirements Age 20 to 32 years Only Female This is a fully on-site position at Motijheel. Candidates must be able to commute to the office regularly and comfortably during the scheduled working hours. Those who may face commuting difficulties are requested not to apply. Experience Fresh graduates are eligible to apply. Candidates with prior experience in customer support or related fields will be given preference. Requirements Must be self-motivated with the ability to work independently under minimal supervision. Detail-oriented and well-organized. Proficient in Google Sheets for data entry, tracking, and reporting. Excellent verbal communication skills—able to speak clearly, confidently, and professionally over the phone. Candidates who are not comfortable communicating effectively over the phone are requested not to apply. Candidates unwilling or unable to strictly follow the defined sales process are requested not to apply. Strong aptitude for sales and interpersonal communication. Patient, responsible, and team-oriented mindset. Responsibilities & Context Contact leads generated through Facebook advertisements, provide parents with detailed information about our product "Bigganbaksho," and convert leads into confirmed sales. Manage outbound calls via CRM and maintain accurate, organized CRM data entry and updates. Track sales performance and regularly update sales data in Google Sheets with precision. Consistently meet daily and weekly call targets. Strictly adhere to the designated sales process and maintain discipline at every stage. Demonstrate a proactive, results-driven attitude toward achieving monthly sales targets. Free physiotherapy services through an in-house consultant. Special discounts on medical tests at renowned hospitals. Career advancement opportunities within the organization. Candidates with Master's degree in Marketing (or MBA) Experience At least 3 years The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): Manufacturing (FMCG), Group of Companies Additional Requirements Age At most 35 years Candidates with valid Driving license (Motor Cycle) will be given preference. Candidates with some experience working in corporate office environment will be given preference. The applicants with experience working with direct sales, business to business sales or institutional sales will be given preference. Candidates over the age of 35 years will not be considered for this post except in exceptional circumstances. Strong command in English (reading, writing, speaking). Friendly personality - approachable, outgoing, assertive Creative minded individuals are preferred for this post. Good organizational skills: ability to prioritize and multi-task Flexible and resourceful at problem-solving Basic computer knowledge (MS., Excel, Internet browsing, E-mail). Responsibilities & Context Job Responsibilities The incumbent will be directly responsible for developing and managing Institutional Sales (Business-to-Business/B2B) for products manufactured and marketed by Quasem Industries PLC and its sister concerns. The role will focus on identifying and developing institutional customers, expanding the B2B customer base, generating sales opportunities, and achieving assigned sales targets. The product portfolio includes Sunlite Battery & Lighter, Sun Chips, Sun Drinking Water, Air Freshener, Pop’s, Pups, Body Spray, and other upcoming consumer products of the Group. The incumbent will establish and maintain strong relationships with corporate organizations, institutions, offices, factories, hotels, restaurants, educational institutions, hospitals, NGOs, government and non-government organizations, distributors, and other potential B2B customers. Identify new business opportunities across institutional and corporate sectors Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline for sustainable business growth Expand the customer base by acquiring new institutional accounts Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and commercial agreements Ensure compliance with organizational policies and customer requirements Develop and execute institutional sales strategies to achieve annual sales and profitability targets He will be fluent in both written and spoken English and Bengali. Candidates must be confident, assured and well-spoken. The employee must maintain good personal hygiene and have a smart appearance. Perform any other jobs as required by the management. Candidates with some experience working in corporate office environment will be given preference. Candidates who have motorcycle driving license will be given preference. Coordinate corrective and preventive actions with Sales, Operations, Compliance, Risk and other relevant functions and support audit requirements. Requirements Education Masters in commerce background from any reputed university. Experience At least 1 year The applicants should have experience in the following business area(s): NGO Additional Requirements Age At most 45 years Minimum 1 years experience in the NGO sector Experience in Hospital management is preferable; Excellent organizational and multi-tasking ability, strong communication, report writing, presentation, and negotiation skills; Proficient in English (oral and written); Age limit could be consider as per candidate experiance. Responsibilities & Context Job Context: Dhaka Ahsania Mission (DAM) is a non-government development organization founded in 1958 by Khan Bahadur Ahsanullah, an eminent educationist, reformer, and Sufi with the aim of social and spiritual development of the entire human community. DAM has been contributing for the betterment of the disadvantaged population through operating 35 institutions and also 8 sectors of development. The Health and Nutrition Sector is one of the core sectors of DAM which has also been operating 7 institutions and 9 projects. DAM Health and Nutrition Sector is going to recruit a competent and self-motivated individual for the position of Accounts and Admin Officer for "Mayer Hashi General Hospital and Diagnostic Center" at Ashulia, Dhaka. Job Responsibility: Oversee day-to-day administrative operations, including scheduling, inventory management, and facility coordination, to ensure efficient hospital functioning. Assist central HR in the overall recruitment and employee HR relevant relevant process. Coordinate effectively with various departments to facilitate smooth and uninterrupted hospital operations. Supervise and manage support staff, including clerical, front desk, housekeeping, and other administrative personnel. Assist in the development, implementation, and periodic review of hospital policies, procedures, and compliance standards. Maintain accurate, confidential, and up-to-date patient records, administrative documentation, and institutional files. Monitor administrative workflows and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and service quality. Manage patient billing, invoicing, account reconciliation, and related financial documentation. Oversee payroll processing and ensure timely and accurate payments to employees, suppliers, and service providers. Prepare and maintain financial reports, budgets, cash-flow projections, and periodic financial forecasts. Monitor hospital expenditures, control operational costs, and implement appropriate cost-saving measures. Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants, financial institutions, and relevant regulatory authorities as required. Ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations, accounting standards, tax requirements, and internal hospital policies. Maintain proper financial records and supporting documentation for audit, reporting, and management review purposes. Provide management with timely financial and administrative information to support effective planning and decision-making. Perform any other tasks time to time given by the authority. As a member of the organization, uphold and comply with DAM’s Safeguarding Policies and Code of Conduct, and take appropriate action to prevent, report, and respond to safeguarding concerns in accordance with established procedures. Skills & Expertise Other Relevant Skills Accounts and audit Administrative Support Financial Management Payroll Administration Staff Supervision Workplace Work at office Employment Status Full Time Job Location Dhaka (Ashulia)
Applicants are encouraged to submit Video CV.

jobs.bdjobs.com/jobdetails?id=1540951&fc.title: Executive - Internal Audit

raw_source_fields.experience: will be an advantage; however, fresh graduates with strong academic credentials from any public university are encouraged to apply. Effective communication and interpersonal skill Critical thinking and analysis The ability to write clear, concise, and grammatically correct English reports is crucial. Problem solving abilities Proficiency in IIA Standards, risks and controls frameworks (COSO etc.) Highest level of integrity Maintains objectivity in appearance and fact Ability to quickly learn new areas of business Flexibility to travel and visit various locations of the organization's partners, including call centers, distribution houses, among others. Responsibilities & Context Support the development of risk-based audit plans and roadmaps aligned with organizational goals, and assist in maintaining the audit universe, risk register, and other relevant tools to continuously assess, link, and prioritize critical business risks. Perform internal audit activities in accordance with IIA Standards, IIA Code of Ethics, Code of Conduct, organizational policies and procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements, while staying updated on audit methodologies, industry best practices, trends, and emerging issues that may impact the business. Demonstrate adherence to established policies and procedures and apply a systematic, disciplined, and value-adding approach to internal audit activities that meets the needs of the organization. Develop and document engagement plans, including objectives, scope, timelines, and resource requirements, considering the organization’s strategies, objectives, and risks relevant to each engagement. Independently perform and document assigned audit engagements by identifying, analyzing, evaluating, and documenting sufficient and appropriate information to achieve engagement objectives within approved timelines, budgets, and departmental standards. Develop, maintain, and update control assessment frameworks, models, criteria, and Risk & Control Matrices (RCMs) at the engagement level to assess the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management, internal controls, processes, and systems. Maintain professional objectivity and independence throughout audit engagements; disclose any actual or perceived impairment of independence or objectivity, ensure balanced assessments based on relevant facts, and avoid undue influence from personal interests or other parties. Consider the possibility of significant errors, fraud, and non-compliance during assigned engagements and conduct appropriate examinations and verifications in line with professional standards and the level of diligence expected from a competent internal auditor. Ensure audit quality and timely delivery by assessing whether engagements adequately cover the approved scope and key risks, objectively evaluate governance, risk management, and controls, identify current business issues and their strategic or operational implications, and provide appropriate recommendations. Communicate audit results in an accurate, objective, clear, concise, constructive, complete, and timely manner, and work with auditees, process owners, and management to develop appropriate action plans and resolve identified control issues and risks. Conduct periodic follow-ups on audit recommendations and action plans, ensure timely implementation of agreed actions, and maintain the audit follow-up tracking system as required by the department. Escalate to the Head of Internal Audit (HIA), through the appropriate channel, where management or divisional heads accept a level of risk that may be unacceptable to the organization. Maintain a thorough and current understanding of the organization’s objectives, strategies, processes, systems, capabilities, employees, culture, industry practices, and business environment to ensure relevant and effective audit assessments. Consider the work of other assurance providers and assess whether reliance on their work is appropriate based on their scope and procedures, while coordinating with other control and monitoring functions to ensure effective use of audit resources. Build and maintain effective working relationships with process owners and business management to support improvements in internal controls, risk management, business processes, effectiveness, and efficiency. Assist the supervisor in functional, administrative, and other audit-related matters as and when required. Skills & Expertise Critical and analytical thinking Problem solving and decision making Target Oriented Compliance and Integrity Risk Assessment Internal Control Audit reporting Data analysis Compliance

Perform internal audit activities in accordance with IIA Standards, IIA Code of Ethics, Code of Conduct, organizational policies and procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements, while staying updated on audit methodologies, industry best practices, trends, and emerging issues that may impact the business.
Demonstrate adherence to established policies and procedures and apply a systematic, disciplined, and value-adding approach to internal audit activities that meets the needs of the organization.
Develop and document engagement plans, including objectives, scope, timelines, and resource requirements, considering the organization’s strategies, objectives, and risks relevant to each engagement.
Independently perform and document assigned audit engagements by identifying, analyzing, evaluating, and documenting sufficient and appropriate information to achieve engagement objectives within approved timelines, budgets, and departmental standards.
Develop, maintain, and update control assessment frameworks, models, criteria, and Risk & Control Matrices (RCMs) at the engagement level to assess the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management, internal controls, processes, and systems.
Maintain professional objectivity and independence throughout audit engagements; disclose any actual or perceived impairment of independence or objectivity, ensure balanced assessments based on relevant facts, and avoid undue influence from personal interests or other parties.
Consider the possibility of significant errors, fraud, and non-compliance during assigned engagements and conduct appropriate examinations and verifications in line with professional standards and the level of diligence expected from a competent internal auditor.
Ensure audit quality and timely delivery by assessing whether engagements adequately cover the approved scope and key risks, objectively evaluate governance, risk management, and controls, identify current business issues and their strategic or operational implications, and provide appropriate recommendations.
Communicate audit results in an accurate, objective, clear, concise, constructive, complete, and timely manner, and work with auditees, process owners, and management to develop appropriate action plans and resolve identified control issues and risks.
Conduct periodic follow-ups on audit recommendations and action plans, ensure timely implementation of agreed actions, and maintain the audit follow-up tracking system as required by the department.
Escalate to the Head of Internal Audit (HIA), through the appropriate channel, where management or divisional heads accept a level of risk that may be unacceptable to the organization.
Maintain a thorough and current understanding of the organization’s objectives, strategies, processes, systems, capabilities, employees, culture, industry practices, and business environment to ensure relevant and effective audit assessments.
Consider the work of other assurance providers and assess whether reliance on their work is appropriate based on their scope and procedures, while coordinating with other control and monitoring functions to ensure effective use of audit resources.
Build and maintain effective working relationships with process owners and business management to support improvements in internal controls, risk management, business processes, effectiveness, and efficiency.
Assist the supervisor in functional, administrative, and other audit-related matters as and when required.
Compensation & Other Benefits
Provident Fund for long-term savings
Mobile Bill
2 weekly holidays for work-life balance
Comprehensive Health/Medical Insurance
Festival Bonus (twice a year)

Full Time
Job Location
Dhaka

Support risk-based internal audits, assess governance, risk and controls, identify control gaps, prepare audit findings and recommendations, and follow up on action plans in line with IIA Standards and regulatory requirements.
